up: List all distinct molecules reported in document CHEMBL3886687. For each molecule, return the ChEMBL ID (chembl_id), the preferred name (pref_name), and the molecule type (molecule_type). Use the molecule_dictionary table, joining it to the compound_records and docs tables to identify the document.
sql: SELECT DISTINCT md.chembl_id, md.pref_name, md.molecule_type FROM docs d JOIN compound_records cr ON d.doc_id = cr.doc_id JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON cr.molregno = md.molregno WHERE d.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL3886687'
